items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: He played with, uh, his name is Orny. I can't think now. He played with, uh, George Lewis.

ctx.x: Uh huh. And uh... Joe Watkins is left handed too. There are two here. Uh huh. And most left handed drummers are good drummers. Can you remember any other left handed drummers around?

Uh huh. You know, uh, yeah I know, Clay Bair, uh, he's about to play trumpet there. He played with, uh, his name is Orny. I can't think now. He played with, uh, George Lewis. Little short bright fella.
